description: Rank the site-and-risk-status groups by share of scans and return exactly 10. Ties at the cut are broken arbitrarily.

c.request: Matching each scan to its site by site code (dropping scans with no matching site), group the scans by site code (`scans.zoneref`) and risk evaluation status (`riskeval`). For each group give the site code, the risk evaluation status, the average compression ratio (`pressratio`, ignoring missing values), the number of scans, and that number as a share of all matched scans. Show the top 10 by share, largest first. Don't round. Rank the site-and-risk-status groups by share of scans and return exactly 10. Ties at the cut are broken arbitrarily.
c.sql:
WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref AS site_code,
    st.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status,
    AVG(s.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS st
    ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.riskeval
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    risk_evaluation_status,
    average_compression_ratio,
    scan_count,
    scan_count * 1.0 / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS share_of_matched_scans
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  risk_evaluation_status,
  average_compression_ratio,
  scan_count,
  share_of_matched_scans
FROM ranked
ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC
LIMIT 10;

b.request: Group matched scans by site code and risk evaluation status, return exactly 10 groups ranked by their share of all matched scans in descending order with ties at the cutoff broken arbitrarily, and for each report the site code, risk evaluation status, average nonmissing compression ratio, scan count, and share without rounding
b.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT zoneref, arcref
  FROM scans
  WHERE zoneref IS NOT NULL
    AND arcref IS NOT NULL
), grouped AS (
  SELECT
    m.zoneref AS site_code,
    s.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status,
    AVG(sc.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM matched m
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
  JOIN scans sc ON sc.zoneref = m.zoneref AND sc.arcref = m.arcref
  GROUP BY m.zoneref, s.riskeval
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  risk_evaluation_status,
  average_compression_ratio,
  scan_count,
  scan_count::numeric / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS share
FROM grouped
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;

a.request: Matching each scan to its site by site code (dropping scans with no matching site), group the scans by site code (`scans.zoneref`) and risk evaluation status (`riskeval`). For each group give the site code, the risk evaluation status, the average compression ratio (`pressratio`, ignoring missing values), the number of scans, and that number as a share of all matched scans. Sort by share from largest to smallest and keep exactly 10 rows; if several groups tie at the 10th place, any of them may fill the remaining spots. Don't round.
a.sql:
WITH matched_scans AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref, si.riskeval, s.pressratio
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
), grouped AS (
  SELECT zoneref, riskeval, AVG(pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM matched_scans
  GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval
)
SELECT zoneref AS site_code,
       riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status,
       avg_compression_ratio,
       scan_count,
       scan_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched_scans) AS share_of_matched_scans
FROM grouped
ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC
LIMIT 10;

d.request: Rank the matched scan groups by site code (`scans.zoneref`) and risk evaluation status (`riskeval`) according to their share of all matched scans, largest first. Return exactly the top 10 groups; break ties at the cutoff arbitrarily. For each group, provide its site code, risk evaluation status, average compression ratio (`pressratio`, ignoring missing values), scan count, and share of all matched scans. Don’t round.
d.sql:
WITH matched_scans AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref, si.riskeval, s.pressratio
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
), group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref AS site_code,
    riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status,
    AVG(pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM matched_scans
  GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  risk_evaluation_status,
  average_compression_ratio,
  scan_count,
  scan_count::numeric / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS share_of_all_matched_scans
FROM group_stats
ORDER BY share_of_all_matched_scans DESC
LIMIT 10;
